## Appearance

Una is a sweet ten-year-old girl who is not considered pretty, with almond-shaped, dark-blue eyes that possess a wistful and sorrowful expression. She wears her straight, dead-black hair in neat braids, which she brushes until it is as smooth as satin without any lawless kinks.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P7](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0007), [v5 CHAPTER XXXIV. UNA VISITS THE HILL P5](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0005)_

## Personality

Una is a sweet, dreamy, and sensitive young girl who dislikes fighting and possesses a deep capacity for sympathy toward others. Extremely shy, she finds asking favors of anyone to be an agony, yet she remains acutely sensitive to public opinion. Though not prone to much laughter, she truly enjoys praying, and her hidden life is driven by the quiet dream of taking music lessons.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P7](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0007), [v5 CHAPTER IV. ## History

Before coming to [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary, Una Meredith lived in [Maywater](../codex/places.md#maywater) and lost her mother when she was six years old. At ten years old, she settled into the manse with her family and quickly formed a close friendship with the neighbouring [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) children in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley). After discovering a starved runaway named [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) hiding in a barn, Una comforted the girl through the night and later plucked up the courage to beg Miss Cornelia to adopt Mary so she would not be sent back to an asylum. During a week when [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) fell ill, Una and [Faith](../character/faith.md) attempted to run the household, inadvertently creating a local scandal by shaking rugs in the graveyard on what neighbors mistook for Sunday. As community gossip and criticism surrounding their father mounted, Una helped establish the Good-[Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#conduct-club) with her siblings to discipline themselves and protect their father's reputation. After a self-imposed daylong fast caused Una to faint during a church service, their father resolved to be more attentive. Fearing the idea of a stepmother due to Mary Vance's stories, Una felt self-conscious about her shabby clothes and worried about local rumors regarding her father's love life. However, upon witnessing her father's deep anguish in his study, Una selflessly visited [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) to beg her to marry him, promising that the children would be good. [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) agreed to write to her father, and Una later celebrated with her family in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) on the eve of the upcoming double wedding.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P0](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P2](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0002), [v5 CHAPTER II. ## Quotes

> "I don’t believe God will send you to hell for telling lies when you didn’t know it was wrong. He couldn’t. Why, He’s kind and good. Of course, you mustn’t tell any more now that you know it’s wrong."
>
> — Una Meredith — [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P107](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0107)

> "Aunt Martha never makes any. But Miss Susan at Ingleside does, and sometimes she lets us have a plateful in Rainbow Valley. Do you know what I do when I’m hungry for doughnuts and can’t get any, Mrs. Elliott?"
>
> — Una Meredith — [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P35](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0035)

> "But God put it into her heart to take you. All my putting it into her head wouldn’t have done any good if He hadn’t."
>
> — Una Meredith — [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P69](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0069)

> "Oh, no, no, Mary. I’m sure it couldn’t be right to pray to the devil. And it wouldn’t do any good because he’s bad. It might aggravate him and he’d be worse than ever."
>
> — Una Meredith — [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P75](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0075)

> "It’s just being a stepmother changes them. Mary says they can’t help it. I wouldn’t mind the whippings so much as having father hate us."
>
> — Una Meredith — [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P86](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0086)
